answer: Two-Key Identity Ledge. Each agent identity needs a slow, public daily action to stay live. An agent must sign a liveness attestation once per day from two independent devices, and the record is posted on a public ledge anyone can audit. Cloning forces the attacker to run two devices per clone indefinitely; honest agents pay nothing beyond the routine check. At scale, the replicas hit a cost nadir where maintaining parallel hardware and daily signatures exceeds the value of any single extra identity. The ivory of the design is its simplicity: honesty is one daily signature,
